sans.$description: Web-only fallback stack the web emitter appends after any `font.family.sans` identity (Brand A Inter, Brand B Figtree). Consumed by the emitter, never emitted as its own custom property. Native platforms bundle the brand font instead (ADR 0014).

mono.$description: Web-only fallback stack the web emitter appends after `font.family.mono` (Roboto Mono). Consumed by the emitter, never emitted (ADR 0014).
